module: Parking spaces as a site carries them and as the level rereads them in its sites file. A space is neither geometry nor paint: it is a box the game looks for when it wants to park a car. It therefore does not go into a shell, but into the level's city.sites.json (parkingSpots field), the only output of a site bake that is not a file of its own. It waits for the "burn": baked locally and written at that time, the copies of a parking lot each have their spaces at their place and at their height.
notes: Baked space: { x, y, yaw, w (width of a space), d (depth), n (number of spaces in the run, absent for a single space), dir ('Left' if the run advances to the left) }. Only the position is recentered; the heading stays, place adds that of the placement to it.

A run of identical spaces side by side is written as ONE multi-space (isMultiSpot, spotAmount = n, spotOffset = 0 because the spaces are joined edge to edge, spotDirection 'Right' by default) like the spaces of hand-made cities.
SPOT_H = 3: height of the box; the position is on the ground and the box extends half a height on each side.
The file is <level folder>/city.sites.json (getMissionFilename). If absent or unreadable, an empty sites file is created in memory { name = 'sites', description, locations, zones, parkingSpots }.
write appends instead of replacing: names prefix + number (skipping those already taken) and oldId beyond the largest existing one, so that two burns and a hand-made space coexist.
write returns nil without a space to write or without a loaded level (sitesPath nil).

SPOT_H.desc: Height of a space's box, in meters (3).

localise.desc: The spaces computed by a site's solver, local to the bake origin. Each space enters in the form { x, y, yaw, w, d, n, dir } and comes out rounded to the millimeter, n and dir omitted for a simple right-hand space. Returns nil if the list is empty.

list.desc: List of spaces { x, y, yaw, w, d, n, dir }.

place.desc: The inverse: the manifest's spaces as parkingSpot records (pos, rot, scl = {width, depth, SPOT_H}, isMultiSpot, spotAmount, spotOffset, spotDirection, spotRotation, color, customFields), placed where a placement is and rotated to its heading. (ox, oy) is the site's pivot (middle of its footprint). groundZ(x, y) gives the ground height, because a space rests on the ground where it is and not on the placement's frame. No name here: they must be unique across the whole level file and are assigned by write.

groundZ.desc: groundZ(x, y) returns the ground height (0 if absent).

returns.desc: List of parkingSpot records, nil if empty.

write.desc: Adds spaces to the level's sites file, under names starting with prefix, keeping what exists. Writes the file with jsonWriteFile.

spots.desc: parkingSpot records returned by place; their name and oldId are filled in by this call.

returns.desc: { path, prev }: what is needed to undo (the array as it was), or nil if there was nothing to add.

restore.desc: Undoes a write: puts the parkingSpots array back exactly as it was.
